LanguageData.XPC_Decay_LevelDescription: Set daily XP decay for skill levels 1-20. Vanilla values are shown for comparison. Level 0 remains protected. Level, skill, and memory adjustments are independent.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_LevelOn: ON: custom decay values are applied.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_LevelOff: OFF: vanilla decay behavior. Saved custom values are preserved.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_RatioDescription: Ratio edits Custom XP/day; only Custom XP/day is saved. For levels 1-9, edit Custom XP/day directly (vanilla = 0).
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_ResetAll: Restore all Decay settings to Vanilla
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_MemoryDescription: 0% means no decay reduction; 100% means no skill decay. Perfect Memory takes precedence when both traits exist. Vanilla Great Memory = 50.00%, Perfect Memory = 100.00%.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_MemoryRange: Allowed: 0.00% - 100.00% (two decimal places). Values apply whenever the trait is present; vanilla values preserve vanilla.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_SkillDescription: Daily decay = level XP/day × skill multiplier × memory remaining factor. Stored multipliers are previewed even while OFF. No automatic link to career XP.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_SkillRange: Allowed: 0.00x - 100.00x | Default 1.00x | Modded skills default to 1.00x.
LanguageData.XPC_Decay_SkillReset: Reset all skill decay multipliers to 1.00x
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_DlcInactive: Biotech is not active. These settings require the Biotech DLC.
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_ComparisonDescription: Compare vanilla skill-gene values with your custom settings.
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_On: On: custom values apply to generated Biotech skill-gene defs.
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_Off: Off: XP Customizer does not modify Biotech skill-gene defs.
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_PassionRemove: Vanilla passion effect: removes all passion
LanguageData.XPC_Biotech_PassionAdd: Vanilla passion effect: adds one passion level
